summary: Validated Pari-chat lazy-provisioning bug fix end-to-end on preview. Drawer opens instantly (~197 ms) with zero upfront /api/doubts/start calls. Opening + closing the drawer multiple times does NOT consume any of the 5 daily doubt sessions (DB row count stayed flat across 4 open + 3 close cycles). Session is provisioned only on first send: sessions_today advanced 0 -> 1 after the first message; turn counter decremented on follow-up. Quota-exhausted handler still present in code. /doubts page loads without errors.

test_E_quota_exhausted_handler_present.note: 429/quota_exhausted branch handles the lazy /doubts/start failure; UI disables composer + surfaces amber block.

test_F_doubts_page_renders.note: Page renders sidebar + hero + Open/Resolved tabs cleanly, no JS errors.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Old openDoubts() awaited POST /api/doubts/start on avatar click before setOpen(true). That call (a) blocked the drawer render (~2s LLM/DB latency) and (b) inserted a user_doubt_sessions row via RPC start_doubt_session, consuming one of the 5 daily quotas even if the user immediately closed the drawer. FIX: openDoubts() now synchronously sets a placeholder session {doubt_session_id: null, turns_left:3, sessions_left_today:null} and calls setOpen(true) immediately. DoubtsSession.send() lazily calls /doubts/start only when the user sends their first message (>=5 chars), then chains /doubts/ask with the returned id. VERIFICATION: DB row count confirmed 0 new sessions across 4 open + 3 close cycles, then +1 exactly on the first send.
